event: 43 Copa del Rey MAPFRE - ORC European Championship
parties: ESP 6810 - Genio IV SOLGREEN - Manuel De Tomas
ESP 6810 - Genio IV - Manuel De Tomas
procedural_matters: ESP 6810 was represented by Manuel De Tomas (helm).
Rafael De Tomas (crew member of ESP 6810) attended the hearing as an observer.
Andres Perez (chairman of the panel of the International Jury) acted as interpreter for the representative of ESP 6810.
facts: ESP 6810 delivered the hearing request at 09:44 on 30 July.

During the hearing, the representative of ESP 6810 stated that he was aware of the fact that he was not a party of the original hearing but still wanted to request the International Jury to reopen the original hearing.
The representative of ESP 6810 also insisted that he did not want to request redress but wanted the International Jury to reopen the original hearing instead.
conclusions: Since ESP 6810 was not a party to the original hearing, she does not have the right to request a reopening of the original hearing. Therefore, the request to reopen is invalid under RRS 63.7(b).
decision: ESP 6810’s request to reopen Hearings No. 1, 7, 8, 9, 10, 12, 13, 15 and 16 is invalid.
